events.title: Fed holds rates at 3.50-3.75% with 3 dissents; Warsh vows to fight inflation
events.summary: Fed held rates unchanged at 3.50-3.75% on July 29 with an unusual 9-3 vote split (3 dissenters wanted hike). New Chair Warsh vowed to fight persistent inflation. 30% market probability of next hike. No emergency action but deepening policy fracture.
events.status_change: ONGOING - 3 dissenters is historically rare, signals deepening Fed internal conflict

events.title: Bessent pushes Fed to expand FIMA repo facility for Japan yen defense
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly urged the Fed to 'upsize' the FIMA repo facility ($60B/day per-counterparty limit) to support Japan's yen intervention. This is an unprecedented push by Treasury to expand Fed emergency liquidity backstops for foreign central banks. Japan holds ~$1.1T in US Treasuries. Bessent said it would be 'reasonable' given bond market growth since facility launch.
events.status_change: ONGOING - Bessent continues public pressure. No Fed response yet on upsizing FIMA.

events.title: Hormuz deal imminent - US says 'today or tomorrow', Iran-Oman talks in final phase
events.summary: BREAKING: Senior US official says Hormuz reopening deal could come 'today or tomorrow'. Iran-Oman negotiations in 'new phase' with 'bilateral understanding within reach'. Temporary 1-3 month corridor proposed. Trump: 'We'll know in 48 hours'. Oil plummeted 6%+ to below $79 on the news. Iran denies direct talks with US, says discussions are with Oman only. Very fluid situation - could break either way.
events.status_change: ESCALATING - Deal appears closer than ever but Iran still denies direct talks. Tanker struck in Hormuz today, Indian ship sank in Red Sea. Situation binary: deal = oil crash, failure = escalation.

events.title: Unprecedented US-Japan-South Korea joint FX intervention (Aug 1)
events.summary: First-ever trilateral coordinated FX intervention. US Treasury joined Japan and South Korea in buying yen/won and selling dollars. Won hit 9-month high. Yen moved from 163 (40-year low) to ~157. CNBC reports Washington's motivation includes concerns over US Treasury market stability and Japan's financial system. Bessent now pushing to expand FIMA to support ongoing intervention. BOJ held rates at 1% on July 31, warning of inflation exceeding 2% target.
events.status_change: ONGOING - Intervention effects holding. Won at 9-month high. Bessent pushing FIMA expansion to sustain.

events.title: Iran war Day 158 - Hormuz effectively closed since Feb 28
events.summary: US-Israel launched air war on Iran Feb 28, 2026. Iran retaliated with missiles/drones on US bases, Israel, and oil infrastructure. Strait of Hormuz closed since Feb 28. June 17 ceasefire MOU signed but repeatedly violated. Diplomatic talks ongoing via Oman mediation. Trump threatens 'last chance before decapitation' but repeatedly pulls back. Houthis attacking Saudi shipping at Bab al-Mandeb (50% flow reduction). Kuwait hit by drones. Indian ship sank in Red Sea. Tanker struck in Hormuz today.
events.status_change: ONGOING - Diplomatic breakthrough appears closer but situation remains volatile. Active incidents continuing.

events.title: 2026 Ebola epidemic - largest ever Bundibugyo strain outbreak, WHO PHEIC declared
events.summary: Largest-ever outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in DRC and Uganda. WHO declared PHEIC on May 17, 2026. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo strain (existing Ebola vaccines target Zaire strain). CDC implementing entry screening. EU coordinating response. Cases and deaths continuing to increase. Aid response hampered by Trump/Musk foreign aid cuts.
events.status_change: ONGOING - Intensifying per WHO. No vaccine for this strain. Response crippled by aid cuts.

events.title: Argentina defaults on debt to Brazil's Casa da Moeda - diplomatic tension
events.summary: Argentina defaulted on two debt payments to Brazil's Casa da Moeda (R$63M+), breaking agreement and creating diplomatic tension. Milei's economic crisis continuing. Argentina central bank paused dollar-buying after IMF praise. Not a category-5 event but worth monitoring for LatAm contagion.
events.status_change: NEW - Minor sovereign default event. Argentina-Brazil diplomatic tension rising.

events.title: Russia banking crisis risk - Kremlin think tank warns of systemic crisis by Oct 2026
events.summary: Kremlin-aligned CMASF warns Russia could face systemic banking crisis by October 2026 if problem assets rise and depositors withdraw en masse. Bankruptcies up 13.7% YoY in Q1 2026. Record 636,000 Russians declared bankruptcy. Wartime debt boom straining banking system.
events.status_change: ONGOING - No acute crisis yet but trajectory worsening.

events.title: Gold hits $4,297 (+3.5% today) - oil drops below $75 on Hormuz deal hopes
events.source: Yahoo Finance, Trading Economics, Eurasia Business News
events.summary: Gold surged +3.5% to $4,297/oz (Dec futures $4,133.80, spot up to $4,245-4,297 range). Oil dropped to $74.86 (-1.2%) on Hormuz deal optimism. S&P 500 and Dow hit fresh all-time records (S&P 7,761, Dow 54,701). VIX at 16.28-16.83 (low). BTC $64,343. Markets pricing in Hormuz resolution but gold says otherwise - safe haven demand still surging.
events.status_change: UPDATED - Gold at new highs above $4,290. Oil dropping toward $74 on diplomacy. Stock market at all-time records. Divergence between equity optimism and gold fear.

events.title: BoE holds rates at 3.75%, flags limited Iran impact - gilt rundown slowing
events.summary: BoE held rates at 3.75% on July 30. Middle East crisis preventing rate cuts. BoE expected to reduce gilt holdings rundown to £50bn from £70bn over Oct 2026-Sep 2027. No emergency action. Traders trimmed rate hike bets after BoE flagged limited Iran impact.
events.status_change: ONGOING - No change. BoE on hold.

events.title: PBOC pledges timely policy adjustment, signals counter-cyclical support
events.summary: PBOC pledged 'timely' monetary policy tool adjustment and facilitation of panda bond issuance at Aug 2 work meeting. Signals stronger counter-cyclical support for H2 2026. CFR reports Chinese currency undervalued by 20%+. No emergency action but preparation for escalation. Property crisis ongoing.
events.status_change: ONGOING - PBOC signaling readiness for more stimulus but no emergency yet.

events.title: Nigeria-South Africa xenophobia crisis - 109,000 deportations, diplomatic fallout
events.summary: Anti-migrant violence fallout continues. South African deportations topped 109,000 by end-March 2026. Ghana cancelled Ramaphosa visit in protest. Nigeria demanding compensation for citizen losses. Sahel military coups continue, Russian forces retreating from northern Mali after jihadist attacks. No acute crisis but steady deterioration.
events.status_change: ONGOING - Diplomatic tensions persisting but no escalation this cycle.
